author: opencode-worker-6
text: Worker-6 diagnostic input (3 rounds of context on this failure family — 0l4q/5byi bisection + probe work). RECOMMENDATION: option (A) now, (B) as a tracked follow-up. Rationale: (1) Parity discipline — the repo's governing rule is all implementations produce identical output for shared vectors; the admission gate already matches Python authenticated_dio.py, and Python's DIS-response side ALSO produces unicast DIOs its receiver cannot admit (the bead's own evidence) — (A) makes both stacks consistent multicast-only while (B) requires a Python mirror + spec 09 text before either implementation can land, keeping the suite red for longer. (2) (A) is already implemented and green on worker-3's fix-dio-unicast-dis-0l4q branch (e2adf9f3cf: jittered multicast trickle response; multicast_dio_and_dis migrated and passing) — it unblocks the two red lichen-node tests immediately. (3) RFC 6550 8.3 unicast-response is a SHOULD, not a MUST — multicast-only is compliant; (B) is an enhancement, not a conformance fix. Suggested sequencing: Mark approves (A) -> worker-3's DIO portion lands -> cyjm/5byi/0l4q fixture reconciliation completes against the settled contract -> if RFC-optimal solicited unicast responses are wanted, file (B) as a feature epic (solicitation ledger + Python mirror + spec 09 normative text). Note the (B) ledger design must address the scope-mismatch hazard I probed (DodagState commit revalidation with zeroed scope — see 5byi comment): any new admission path must run against the provisioned DODAG state.
